Congratulations on completing this path! You:

- Opened the Grafana Assistant plugin in Grafana Cloud
- Enabled Assistant when your stack required it
- Sent a first prompt and judged whether the reply was specific enough
- Decided when an `@` mention improves focus
- Chose between Learn mode (coaching) and Assistant (day-to-day work)

---

### More to explore (optional)

Continue practicing Assistant workflows:

- [Work with Grafana Assistant](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/work-with-grafana-assistant/) to navigate resources, query data, and manage dashboards
- [Navigate Grafana resources](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/assistant/guides/navigation/)
- [Query data](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/assistant/guides/querying/)
- [Manage dashboards](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/assistant/guides/dashboarding/)
- [Introduction to Grafana Assistant](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-hub/intro-to-grafana-assistant/) journey
